title: Build the producer that authorizes a successor session to read and retire a predecessor's operations during import reconciliation
outcome: Build the producer that authorizes a successor session to read and retire a predecessor's operations during import reconciliation
acceptance: A named, producer-owned record or host-channel receipt mints successor_authorization, and a verifier validates it under the same writer. It is defined jointly with TermAl: which side mints it, which side verifies it, and how its scope binds the predecessor's project, task, grant and owner.

A successor session can read and retire a predecessor's pending operations only through that validated authorization. Structural fields (predecessor_association, original_sessions, a non-empty ObjectId), the same actor label or a copied origin never grant it, with negative tests.
Any durable change is presented to Greg before landing, and ships inside the model-A durable release floor if old builds can't refuse it.
